title: Dear future me
content: Dear future me, I created this blog to give you a public second brain. My intention is to use writing as a tool to deepen the things I learn. And why not share all that with clankers and people on the internet? So this second brain will mostly consist of all things terminal, keyboard centric workflows and occasionally some dev topics. It obviously has huge "it works on my machine" vibes, and you will encounter clanker written code. I will try to keep it short and concise. A word on how to use this page. You can sort articles by creation date and use a fuzzy search via CMD/CTL + K. The git branches in the prompt represent categories. Maybe there will be a filter in the future for these branches. I was planning on implementing vim motions for the blog, but since the vimium browser extension exists I shouldn't mess with these key assignments. So let's hope I keep it consistent and I hope I will bring astro with the current structure to its limits. Stets Kaith
